display_name: Charities (Jersey) Law 2014 (L.41/2014): the whole Law, nine groups and an integration layer
source: Charities (Jersey) Law 2014, official consolidated version on jerseylaw.je, showing the law from 02 Oct 2026 to Current; terms in SOURCE-LICENSE.md

scope.encoded: The Title, the Long title, Articles 1 to 43 in nine Parts, Schedule 1 (Jersey Charity Commissioner), Schedule 2 (Charity Tribunal) and the endnotes: 851 provisions, covered by nine groups (G1 Articles 1 and 2; G2 Articles 3 to 7; G3 Articles 8 to 10; G4 Articles 11 and 12; G5 Articles 13 and 14; G6 Articles 15 to 20; G7 Articles 21 to 25, 37 to 43 and the endnotes; G8 Articles 26 to 36; G9 Schedules 1 and 2), the nine point-in-time texts from 1 January 2019 to 2 October 2026, and the three stages of commencement; with an integration layer (int- modules) that wires the groups through 35 integration points and answers six headline questions; three independent test authors' tests are merged into the row (the ind- modules). Coverage by provision: coverage-all.tsv.
scope.not_encoded: The subordinate legislation made under the Law (R&O.19/2018, R&O.59/2018, R&O.60/2018); the content of every Order and set of Regulations the Law empowers (inputs where a rule needs them); the other enactments the Law mentions (inputs); any text of the Law before 1 January 2019 or after 2 October 2026 (refusals or the latest text); see NOTES.md sections 1 and 9.

check: check.sh (five to ten minutes, depending on the machine; needs the l4 binary named by l4_binary_sha256)
not_reviewed: No domain expert (a Jersey charity lawyer, or anyone who knows the Jersey Charity Commissioner's practice) has read any module of this encoding against the Law. The group encoders checked their own modules against the text of the Law as they say in FRAGMENT-G1.md to FRAGMENT-G9.md; the integrator checked the wiring between the groups and the six headline functions; three independent test authors decided scenarios from the Law before opening the encoding, and their tests are in the row (NOTES.md section 12), with the post-hoc ones labelled. Nothing here is verified beyond that, and nothing here is legal advice.
encoder_detail: A fleet of AI agents run by Legalese in October 2026: nine group encoders (G1 to G9), one integrator, one overlap reader, one comparer (Claude Sonnet 5.5), a blind contradiction hunter and three independent test authors (Claude Opus 5.5), directed by one launching session (Claude Sonnet 5.5). The models, dates and cost are recorded in NOTES.md section 15.
versions_encoded: The Official Consolidated Version showing the law from 2 October 2026 to current, as retrieved 2026-10-14 and again 2026-10-26 (the paragraph text of the two retrievals is identical). The row also handles the nine point-in-time texts and the staged commencement of the Law through its vintage and commencement layer (NOTES.md sections 2 and 3); it does not reconstruct the text before 1 January 2019.
assertions_note: Satisfied assertions in a clean-copy run of check.sh on 2026-10-27, 162 modules; 157 further assertions fail on purpose and 10 are refused on purpose, each counted per file in expected_red and expected_refused.
